item.title: 微软AI发布MAI-Cyber-1-Flash：一款5B活跃参数的网络安全模型，将MDASH在CyberGym上的表现提升至95.95%
item.description:
【marktechpost.com】微软AI发布了MAI-Cyber-1-Flash，这是其首款专为网络防御构建的模型。该模型总参数量为137B，活跃参数为5B，是基于MAI-Code-1-Flash的稀疏MoE微调版本，支持256k上下文窗口。该模型并非作为独立端点提供，而是运行在微软的多模型代理扫描框架MDASH中，在其中处理高达90%的任务，并将系统在CyberGym上的表现提升至95.95%。本文《微软AI发布MAI-Cyber-1-Flash：一款5B活跃参数的网络安全模型，将MDASH在CyberGym上的表现提升至95.95%》最初发表于MarkTechPost。

item.title: LEAD: Breaking the No-Recovery Bottleneck in Long-Horizon Reasoning
item.description:
【machinelearning.apple.com】Long-horizon execution in Large Language Models (LLMs) remains unstable even when high-level strategies are provided. Evaluating on controlled algorithmic puzzles, we demonstrate that while decomposition is essential for stability, extreme decomposition creates a “no-recovery bottleneck”. We show that this bottleneck becomes critical due to highly non-uniform error distribution, where consistent errors on a few “hard” steps become irreversible.
